                    (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), d.weight y ≤ d.weightMax) →
                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsClassScalar d.order d.weight →
                        (∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
                          (∀ (j : Fin k), d.slope j ≠ 0) →
                            0 ≤ d.ellipsoidRadius →
                              (∀ j ∉ d.activeSet, d.ellipsoidRadius ≤ |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                (∀ (z : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    |∑ j, d.frame.mulVec z j ^ 2 - ∑ j, z j ^ 2| ≤ d.frameDefect * ∑ j, z j ^ 2) →
                                  d.frameDefect < 1 →
                                    ContinuousOn d.rotationRate (Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius) →
                                      ContinuousOn d.multiplier (Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius) →
                                        (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius, ContDiff ℝ 1 (d.profile p)) →
